description: Velnor V1: propose ALL updates (major + minor/patch) as reviewed changes; never merge, never touch tool inputs.

packageRules.description: Cargo majors need explicit migration review (VER-3.2: incompatible = migration, never silent).
Cargo minor/patch updates ride the normal qualification gate.
Refresh only Velnor-owned pins/locks; never propose tool-input edits (VER-3.4). Defense-in-depth: mise is not in enabledManagers, so this rule only bites if mise is ever enabled.
x509-cert 0.3 makes tbs_certificate private (E0616); upgrading is a code change, so hold 0.2.x until that lands.
The alint pin is a reviewed policy pin; changes need policy review.
